"import cadquery as cq

# Define the YZ plane
P = cq.Plane.named("YZ")

# Define local coordinates for the chain
local_points = [
    (0, 0),
    (19, 0),
    (19, 14),
    (7, 14),
    (7, 32),
    (-15, 32),
    (-15, -9)
]

# Convert local coordinates to global coordinates (x, y, z) = (0, u, v)
world_points = [P.toWorldCoords((u, v)) for u, v in local_points]

# Create the 6 line segments as edges
edges = [
    cq.Edge.makeLine(world_points[i], world_points[i + 1])
    for i in range(len(world_points) - 1)
]

# Create a compound of edges and export to STEP file
compound = cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges)
cq.exporters.export(compound, "sketch.step")"
